title: First correction to the critical mean degree in extreme long-range percolation
description: Unrefereed analytic candidate for the first correction to the critical expected degree in one-dimensional extreme long-range percolation with linear bond probabilities. Includes a sufficient kernel criterion, nonnegative summable additions and compact exponent mixtures. Internal AI-assisted scrutiny and finite algebraic diagnostics are not formal verification or independent human peer review. Component-specific rights are specified in LICENSES.md; code is MIT and historical third-party material is NOASSERTION.
references: Heydenreich, van der Hofstad and Sakai (2008). doi:10.1007/s10955-008-9580-5
van der Hofstad and Sakai (2005). doi:10.1007/s00440-004-0405-4
